display_long_description:
# Stream XBOX games directly on your Meta Quest     

Stream up to hundreds of games* like Halo Infinite, Forza Motorsport and Starfield on a massive 2D virtual display in Meta Quest with XBOX Game Pass via cloud gaming. You can also play select games installed on your console via Remote Play.

Access a library of 50+ games with a starter edition of XBOX Game Pass with Meta Horizon+** and use your go-to gaming controller to play your favorite games. 

[media]

# Customize your screen

Adjust the screen to fit your space and comfort level, from a big screen TV to an expansive display for epic battles.

[media]

# Progress goes with you

Start a game on your Meta Quest and seamlessly continue on XBOX console, PC, or mobile devices with cloud gaming. With cloud saves, your progress stays synced no matter how you play*.


*Via the XBOX app, free in the Meta Horizon Store. XBOX Cloud Gaming: Requires supported device and Xbox Game Pass subscription (both sold separately). Game catalog varies (xbox.com/play). Select regions (Xbox.com/regions) and devices (xbox.com/cloud-devices). Terms apply. XBOX Remote Play: Requires Microsoft Account with XBOX profile, supported controller and supportedconsole. Some games and online console multiplayer require XBOX Game Pass subscription. Games, console, controller, and subscription sold separately.

** Eligibility rules and terms apply: www.meta.com/legal/quest/meta-horizon-plus-terms . Streaming limits apply. Select regions.
